$comment: Copied into the calibration sandbox as .claude/settings.local.json. Both marketplace installs of the pipeline plugin are disabled so the sandbox only ever runs the plugin build under calibration. This file carries permissions and enabledPlugins only: the observability hooks (tool-use log, subagent log, agent-cost capture) come from the plugin manifest of the build under calibration, which scripts/calibration-run.sh loads via --plugin-dir "$LAUNCH_HARNESS" (#1616), and the sandbox pipeline.config sets PIPELINE_LOGS_ENABLED=true so a calibration run still prices itself. Registering them here too would double-fire. Dogfood-only hooks are deliberately not carried.
